title: Cyclohexane Inclusion Compound with 2,2-Dibutyl-N,N′-di(1-naphthyl)malonamide
abstract: Abstract                A novel clathrate-type inclusion compound has been formed from recrystallization of 2,2-dibutyl-N,N′-di(1-naphthyl)malonamide with restricted organic molecules, which was characterized by the thermal analyses (DSC and TGA) and the X-ray structural analysis.
